lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: Round-1 review WARNING on src/commands/plan.ts:167 is fixed: buildNotPlannableReason's missing-criteria branch (added in US-001) was implemented but unreachable by any test, since every fixture that reached resolveSpecificIssue already carried a non-empty spec.acceptanceCriteria. Added test/plan.test.ts 'AC4: returns 1 and names the missing-criteria case when spec.acceptanceCriteria is empty' -- a specified/open/unblocked fixture with an empty acceptanceCriteria array, asserting exit 1, no state-file write, and that the captured stderr matches /no acceptanceCriteria in spec/ (had to also pass sidecarAliveFn: () => true, since the sidecar-liveness gate in runPlan runs before resolveSpecificIssue and the other F-01 tests in this suite don't check message content so they never needed it). Verified the assertion is genuinely falsifiable per the patterns.md oracle-falsifiability rule: temporarily deleted the missing-criteria branch in plan.ts, confirmed the new test goes red (captured stderr became 'not plannable' instead), then restored the branch (net-zero diff on plan.ts, confirmed via git diff --stat). Raised test/plan.test.ts's file-size ceiling 629->670 (629->669 for the test body, +1 for the sidecarAliveFn line) in scripts/file-size-budget.json with a CAM-449 tracker ref prepended to _ref. scripts/cam/prd.json's review block (round 1, 3 remaining SUGGESTIONs on issue-file-spec-channel.test.ts real-CLI coverage, spec.ts entry-level string validation, and an em-dash in patterns.md:1080) is harness-written state from the supervisor's review dispatch, not touched by this story -- those SUGGESTIONs are non-blocking per the round's FIXES_PENDING:1 verdict (only the WARNING gated this fix story) and are left for the supervisor's terminal-verdict follow-up filing if still open when review goes terminal. Full bun test suite (5750 pass / 0 fail) and bun run check:all (all gates ok, including coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps/skip-ratchet) both green on this branch.
